summary: Comprehensive testing of major refactor: New config-based timetable generation system. Backend: 20/20 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All major features working (100%). Fixed capacity overflow warning bug. The new /api/generate endpoint correctly accepts config body with className, workingDays, hoursPerDay, durationMinutes, startTime, and subjects array. Timetable grid displays days as columns, time slots as rows, with Subject + Teacher display, lunch break row, and free period styling. 1 subject per day constraint verified. Credit-based distribution working correctly.
